interface.title: JalRakshak 360
interface.field: Public health / drinking-water quality and hydrology (rural water-safety monitoring in Uttarakhand, India)
interface.stage_of_work: Monitoring, triage and decision support: ranking monitored villages and planning field interventions, with checks on where the input data come from
interface.what_it_is_for: A single-page Streamlit dashboard that ranks monitored villages by an explainable drinking-water risk score fused with an AI anomaly score, maps them, explains why each one was flagged, lets you try a what-if rainfall change, and sets the result beside WQ6 water-quality, groundwater-telemetry, census and data-source panels so you can see where each input comes from.

data.note: The app loaded data/processed/water_risk_with_rainfall.csv: 12 prototype villages (Village_A–L) in 6 Uttarakhand districts. Nothing was uploaded. data/processed/* is gitignored, so the processed files are not shipped with the repo. The run's seed step wrote wqmis_up_2026_2027_risk.csv so the app would start. The WQ6 panel in this run (7 Uttar Pradesh districts, 185 indicators, Firozabad 77) is therefore a synthetic stand-in, not the README's real JJM/WQMIS integration (75 districts, 262 indicators). Every WQ6 number in t10 and f6 is seeded. This run did not establish where the village, groundwater-telemetry and Census files came from.

features.name: Faceted site filter driving KPI cards, map and ranked queue
features.general: Pick a region and a severity class in two dropdowns. Summary counts, map markers and the ranked work-list all narrow to the matching sites, with an explicit empty state when nothing matches
features.specific: The sidebar District and Risk Level selectboxes recompute Locations Monitored / Critical / High / P1 / Population Covered, redraw the Folium map, filter the Intervention Priority Queue, and restrict the Location Intelligence village list
steps: Choose a District (All or one of 6)
Choose a Risk Level (All/CRITICAL/HIGH/WATCH/LOW)
Read the updated KPI cards
See the map and priority queue reduced to the matching sites
If nothing matches, the queue shows 'empty' and Location Intelligence shows 'No locations match the selected filters'
serves_tasks: Filter sites by region and see the summary counts update
Combine the region filter with a severity filter
List only the highest-severity sites across all regions

features.name: Risk-coloured point map with popups
features.general: Show sites as markers coloured by severity class. Zoom and pan, hover a marker for a short label, click it for a popup with that site's scores
features.specific: Folium/Leaflet Water Risk Map: orange = HIGH, blue = WATCH, green = LOW. Tooltip 'Village_G - HIGH'; popup gives District, Final Risk, Level, Priority and AI Anomaly. +/− and wheel zoom
steps: Scan marker colours to spot high-severity sites
Zoom in with + or the mouse wheel to separate clustered markers
Hover a marker to see its name and level
Click a marker to open the score popup
serves_tasks: Identify a site on the map and read its key scores

features.name: Ranked intervention queue table
features.general: A sortable, searchable work-list of sites ranked by combined risk score, with level, priority tier and a separate anomaly score. Re-sorting by the anomaly score shows where the two rankings disagree. Columns can be hidden and the table opened fullscreen
features.specific: Intervention Priority Queue dataframe (Village, District, Risk Score, Risk Level, Priority P1–P3, AI Anomaly), sorted by Risk Score (fused final risk) by default
steps: Open the table fullscreen to see all columns
Click a column header to sort (e.g. AI Anomaly descending)
Use Show/hide columns to drop a column
Exit fullscreen
serves_tasks: Compare the ranking by the combined risk score with the ranking by the separate anomaly score

features.name: Single-site factor breakdown with reasons and actions
features.general: Pick one site to see its headline scores, a bar chart of the factors behind its score, the top three reasons in plain text, and recommended actions tagged by priority
features.specific: Location Intelligence: Final Risk / Risk Level / Priority / AI Anomaly metrics, Risk Factors Vega bar chart (5 factors, tooltip, Show-data table toggle), 'Why was this location flagged?' top-3 list, and Recommended Actions (P1/P2/P3)
steps: Select a location (list follows the sidebar filters)
Read the headline score metrics
Hover factor bars or press Show data to read exact factor values
Read the top-3 flag reasons
Read the prioritised recommended actions
serves_tasks: Break one site's score down into its contributing factors
Contrast a high-priority site with a low-priority one

features.name: What-if driver slider with before/after delta
features.general: Choose an item and drag a percentage slider for one input driver. See the original and simulated input, the recomputed score with a coloured +/− delta, and the resulting class. Only the transparent rule-based score is recomputed; the combined score that also includes the anomaly model is not, so the scenario class can differ from the item's headline class
features.specific: What-If Rainfall Simulator: location select (all villages), 'Simulated rainfall change (%)' slider from −50 to +100 in steps of 10 (drag or keyboard End/Arrow keys), with Original Rainfall, Simulated Rainfall, Scenario Risk (+delta) and Scenario Level cards from the rule-based engine (e.g. Village_G 49.63 WATCH vs fused 64.74 HIGH)
steps: Select a location
Drag the slider, or focus it and press End/Home/Arrow keys
Compare original and simulated rainfall
Read the scenario risk and its delta badge
Check whether the scenario level changes
serves_tasks: Run high and low scenarios for one site
Repeat the scenario for the top-priority site, and set its rule-based score beside its combined score

features.name: Region burden ranking with per-parameter drill-down chart
features.general: A ranked table of total reported problem counts per region, plus a selector that draws a per-parameter bar chart for one region and shows a message when that region has none
features.specific: WQ6 panel: KPI cards (districts reported, with contamination, total indicators, highest burden), Highest Contamination Burden table, and a District-wise WQ6 Detail selectbox driving a 15-parameter bar chart (Arsenic, Fluoride, Nitrate, E. coli …), with a 'No non-zero WQ6 contamination indicators' message for zero districts. In this run the panel showed a seeded stand-in file (7 districts, 185 indicators), not real WQMIS data
steps: Read the KPI cards and the ranked burden table
Select a district
Read the per-parameter bar chart
Select a zero-burden district to see the empty-state message
